Subject: Quick debrief: Jamie Patel (SWE II) — please drop scores by 3pm PT

Hi all,

Thanks for joining the loop earlier. Candidate Jamie Patel finished onsite yesterday — attached are the resume and portfolio link for reference. Can everyone drop their completed scorecard into the attached Scorecard_Template.xlsx by 3pm PT today? Hiring committee needs a consolidated pass/fail + level rec by EOD so we can decide whether to move to an onsite follow-up or offer.

Key calibration notes from my perspective:
- Strong systems design, latency-conscious tradeoffs
- Pair-programming flagged a couple of sloppy edge-case tests
- Communication was crisp but occasionally terse with product context

If you have low confidence in any rating, add a one-line justification in the 'Notes' column so we can adjudicate quickly. I'll compile and propose an initial recommendation after 3pm.

Attachments: Jamie_Patel_Resume.pdf, Jamie_Patel_Portfolio_Link.txt, Scorecard_Template.xlsx

—Marissa

Subject: Consolidated scores + proposed path — Jamie Patel (SWE II)

Thanks everyone — I pulled the submitted scorecards and created a short reconciled summary (attached Debrief_Summary_JP_v1.xlsx). Quick numbers: mean technical = 3.6, coding = 3.2, design = 3.9, communication = 4.0. Votes: 3x hire (SWE II with mentorship), 2x hold for follow-up (design/testing mini-interview).

Proposal: because the committee is split and concerns cluster around testing rigor and handling edge-cases, propose a 30-minute targeted follow-up with Jonas + Mina to run one test-first coding exercise and one edge-case design question. If candidate demonstrates clear improvement on testing approach, we move forward with a calibrated SWE II offer. If not, close with a no-hire.

Action items: 
- Marissa: coordinate with Sarah/Highline to confirm candidate availability for a 30m loop (ideally tomorrow morning PT).
- Jonas + Mina: draft 2 focused prompts (one code, one design) and ping Tessa when ready.
- All: please mark final 'recommendation' column in the scorecard (hire/hold/no-hire) by 11am PT tomorrow so we can finalize language for the recruiter.

Calendar link (draft): https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

—Tessa
